description: This deposit provides updated techno-economic inputs for modelling decarbonisation pathways in the Philippines with OSeMOSYS. The research team compiles power-plant capacity, generation, demand, energy-resource potential and emerging-technology parameters from public sources. The article covers historical and projected demand through 2050; the released Excel workbook is named for updates over 2022–2050. Zenodo provides free CC BY 4.0 access. Repository metadata explicitly state that unchanged model data come from the Philippines Starter Data Kit and that renewable costs use a separate update source. A limitation is its dependence on separate starter-kit inputs; it is not a self-contained executable model. A reviewer-assessed use is parameterizing national electricity-transition simulations, including offshore wind, floating solar and tidal options. model-osemosys is the documented modelling environment. No workbook, starter-kit payload or optimization model was downloaded, so completeness of a runnable input set was not demonstrated.
name: Philippines OSeMOSYS decarbonisation input updates, 2022–2050
